title: Password input has no autocomplete attribute
description: An <input type="password"> field with no autocomplete attribute at all — inconsistent with the codebase's own pattern elsewhere (autocomplete="new-password"), and leaves default (unrestricted) browser autofill/caching behavior on a credential field.

title: Possible hardcoded secret in config file
description: key=value or key: value assignment (no quotes, no placeholder) whose key name suggests a password/secret/token/api key — common in .properties, .yml, and .env files where secrets are not string-literal quoted
